parsed.summary: The netlist implements the specified architecture: TPS2121 power mux arbitrating 12 V and USB 5 V into VBUS, AP63203WU buck to 3.3 V, ESP32-C3 SPI to three MAX31855 channels with GPIO4/6/7 chip-selects, GPIO1 driving the TPS1H200 high-side heater switch, and two fan-tach inputs with TVS protection. Differences from the specification text are mostly reference-number/test-point shifts or already documented known limitations, not behavior-changing deviations supported by the files.
